title: Chapter 34
text:
The dilapidated skyscrapers were crawling with vines, the broken bridges were covered with moss, and the streets were deserted. The windows of the shops along the streets were shattered, and the shelves were overturned. It was obvious that this place had been robbed.

A yellowed newspaper from who knows how long ago was swaying on the ground with the wind. The atmosphere was bleak everywhere.

The moonlight passed through the dust and dimmed the city. It was the only source of light in this city.

This was a deserted city that once belonged to a large country. Now, the country had disappeared. In the tide of the era change, the citizens had migrated out of this dead city. Even the wanderers were unwilling to live in this dead city.

In the decades of the reshuffling of the entire planet's social environment, many cities were abandoned and became part of the planet's ecological environment again. From a cold steel forest, it gradually became a green field full of life. It made people wonder what the meaning of human beings was to the planet.

According to Han Xiao's intelligence, there were three Germinal Organization sub-bases in Stardragon, and this dead city was one of them. It was like a nail that was stuck in the body, causing the upper echelons of Stardragon to be shocked and angry. Within twenty-four hours, the nearest military base was deployed to attack this sub-base. The operation was very efficient.

At this time, the dead city was awakened by artillery fire. More than ten Stardragon military bulletproof assault vehicles charged at the sub-base. The sound of gunfire and explosions was continuous, mixed with screams and roars.

However, the main battlefield was not the core of the operation.

Three members of the Secret Operations Department were quietly approaching the Germinal Organization sub-base from the side. Their mission was to sneak in and steal information while the army was engaged in battle.

The Secret Operations Department was responsible for infiltration, infiltration, destruction, theft, assassination, and similar matters. It was also known as the Secret Service Department, and its members were the best of the best.

The three members of the Secret Service Department avoided the battlefield and approached the sub-base from the other side. When they arrived at the side door of the sub-base, the team's hackers cracked the door control.

Li Ya Lin, a member of the Secret Operation Team, a Level Four Special Agent. She was a beautiful young woman. She wore a black one-piece sports bodysuit that outlined her hot figure that could make people's blood boil. She wore a loose yellow hoodie and looked very sporty. Her skin was white and beautiful, and her temperament was lively like an elf. She wore silver round earrings and light eyeshadow. She had a high nose bridge, and her facial features were defined.

Li Ya Lin stretched her back, her beautiful waist showed amazing elasticity, which was out of tune with the tense atmosphere around her. She chewed on her bubble gum and complained, "It's not easy to take advantage of the fact that the captain is recuperating and has a vacation, but the department gave us an emergency mission. They don't treat special agents as human beings!"

Lambert silently wiped his gleaming dagger. He was as silent as a rock. He used to be an ace soldier in a secret unit. After he was "retired," he joined Division 13's Covert Operations Department. He wore a field military uniform, a belt with more than ten daggers around his waist, and a folded black heavy sniper rifle slung across his back.

"This … this operation seems to be very important to the bureau."

Lin Yao stuttered. He was a little over 1.7m tall, and he looked a little shy. He was the team's hacker. He carried a small backpack with a lot of electronic equipment, and he was currently hacking into the side door of the base. He took out a bunch of electronic equipment and connected it to the security system. His fingers flew across the keyboard, and code flowed out like a waterfall.

Not long after, the code was cracked, and the metal door opened automatically.

The three of them looked at each other and snuck into the base.

Li Ya Lin walked in front, Lin Yao in the middle, and Lambert at the back. Lin Yao, who had hacked into the system, opened all the security systems along the way. Their target was the main computer room.

The Germinal Organization placed great importance on secrecy. If a base was attacked and threatened to fall, the guards would immediately reformat the base's system and destroy all information. They would also activate an EMP to cut off the network and power to burn the main computer's electronic components. This was why the Germinal Organization had always been so mysterious, like a cloud of fog. Division 13 valued Han Xiao so much because he was such a rare source of information.

They arrived at the second floor of the basement without much trouble. The main computer room was right in front of them. Suddenly, Lin Yao saw the hacked surveillance screen and shouted, "There's an enemy team in the corner ahead …"

Before he could finish, a group of guards appeared in their line of sight. A battle was about to break out!

Li Ya Lin was the first to react. She suddenly burst into a blur of speed and rushed to the front of the guards before they could open fire. She leaped into the air, her body as light as a swallow, and her long legs did a 180-degree split. She viciously kicked the two guards in the head, and the two guards were sent spiraling into the air, their necks broken.

Li Ya Lin's body was extremely strong. Not only was her flexibility amazing, but her strength was also equally shocking. She supported herself with both hands on the ground and stood upside down. She rotated her legs, releasing a bright yellow aura that swept through the crowd like a yellow propeller. Even if someone tried to block it with a gun, the gun would explode into pieces. The strength of her legs could even bend metal!

"A martial artist!"

The last guard turned pale with fright. Just as he was about to call for reinforcements, Lambert swiped his hands across the knife pouch at his waist, and a silver flying dagger instantly pierced the guard's throat.

A fully armed team was quickly wiped out by Li Ya Lin and Lambert.

At that moment, the lights in the corridor turned blood-red, and ear-piercing alarms rang out everywhere.

Lin Yao screamed, "We've been discovered! A large number of guards are rushing toward us, and the base's system has started reformatting! "

Li Ya Lin was also anxious. "Hurry up and unlock the access to the main computer room!"

"I'm working on it, but it'll take at least three minutes. The enemy will arrive in at most one minute. I … I really can't bypass the firewall and unlock the access in such a short time. I'm … I'm sorry …" Lin Yao was sweating profusely as he typed furiously on his tablet. His fingers moved at the speed of a bachelor for several lifetimes, but there was no movement from the main computer room's steel door.

Soon, chaotic footsteps could be heard coming from both ends of the corridor. This was a straight corridor, and there was no place to hide. They were confident that they could kill their way out, but their mission was doomed to fail.

"Oh right, didn't the higher-ups give us new equipment before we set off?" Li Ya Lin suddenly remembered something. She hurriedly took out a long black package from Lin Yao's backpack.

Opening the zipper, a mechanical arm with a metallic texture lay quietly inside.

Lightweight Mechanical Arm!

"How do we use this thing? Have any of you read the manual? "

Lin Yao hurriedly said, "Put your left hand in it, and your thumb will activate it. Speaking of which, will this thing really not explode? It's not like you don't know those idiots in the R&D department …"

There was a saying in Division 13: Any product from the R&D department is bound to be risky!

"There's no other choice. Let's just give it a try." Li Ya Lin steeled her heart and put on the mechanical arm. She looked as if she was prepared to lose her arm. It was obvious how unpopular the R&D department was.

The mechanical arm was successfully activated, and it buzzed.

"It actually didn't malfunction!"

What a shock!

Li Ya Lin gritted her teeth and slammed her fist on the metal door of the main engine room. Surprisingly, the impact created a very obvious dent. Li Ya Lin was overjoyed. Her fists rained down on the metal door at high speed. With the help of the machine and her own strength, many deformed dents appeared on the metal door. The door frame let out a tearing sound.

Twenty seconds passed in the blink of an eye, and the large group of guards finally arrived at the corner of the corridor. At that moment, the metal door of the main engine room finally gave in and flew out with a bang.

Li Ya Lin and the other two hurriedly hid behind the door.

"That was close."

Lin Yao immediately connected the device to the mainframe. The formatting of the system was at 57%. He had to make a backup copy of the remaining contents as soon as possible. He also had to hack into the Germinal Organization's database to steal as much information as possible before the internet and power were cut off.

With the room as cover, Li Ya Lin and Lambert unleashed their full power. Li Ya Lin pulled out a metal baton from her pocket and swiftly took down the guards who rushed into the main engine room. She swung the baton in her right hand and used the mechanical arm in her left hand. With a bright yellow flame burning in her left hand, she was able to break the bones of the guards through their bulletproof vests.

On the other hand, Lambert's flying daggers were deflected through the wall and hit the enemies outside the door. The guards screamed in pain.

With just the two of them, they were able to cause so much damage that hundreds of guards were unable to do anything.

Not long after, the base's system completed its self-formatting. Then, the power and internet were cut off, and the entire base was plunged into darkness.

"Charge!" Li Ya Lin roared. She punched, kicked, and swung her baton, carving out a bloody path. Lambert and Lin Yao followed closely behind.

There were screams everywhere, and the darkness was a mess.

After a fierce battle, the three of them finally made it out of the base. Only then did they heave a sigh of relief. Lin Yao was paralyzed on the ground, but the other two were already used to it. Every time a mission ended, Lin Yao would be scared to death.

Li Ya Lin played with the Lightweight Mechanical Arm lovingly. Lin Yao glanced at it and asked in surprise, "Who invented this mechanical arm? Was it Luo Xuan from the logistics department?"
